question_text: $A$, $B$, $C$ and $D$ represent vertical cross sections of four identical parallel rectangular metal plates placed normal to the plane of the paper. Each of the plates $A$, $B$, $C$ and $D$ has a small hole at its centre. The three plates are arranged so that their holes are coaxially placed as shown in figure (a). Plate $A$ is grounded and the entire system is in a vacuum. A stationary particle of charge $+q$ and mass $m$ is placed at the end $O$ of the plates. The plates are given suitable voltages $V_A$, $V_B$, $V_C$ and $V_D$ and applied to the plates to obtain the velocity ($v$) -- time ($t$) curve shown in figure (b) for the electron'. (Assume that the given voltages are suitable for practical use and that the edge effects and gravitational effects can be neglected.)
